description: This file declares the IniFile class which manages reading, writing, and storing key-value pairs for configuration stored in an INI file. It includes methods for loading a file, retrieving and setting values, and clearing data.
external_files: conditionally included if GTEST_ENABLE is defined

classes.name: IniFile
classes.description: A class for handling INI configuration files, providing methods to load, clear, get, and set key-value pairs, and flush changes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the INI file specified by filename into memory.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, or a default value if the key is not found.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value for a specified key.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Writes any changes back to the INI file (though implementation details are not shown in the header).
